hero.slogan: "In the name of blocks, open to the world."
hero.description: iGCraftLit is a community for Minecraft creators. Gathered by blocks, we bring together players who love building and exploring to shape an open, free gaming ecosystem.

why.label: WHY
why.p1: iGCraftLit — in the name of blocks. Blocks stand for creation, curiosity and perseverance — exactly how we approach games and life.
why.p2: We believe a community should be open, free, and player-owned. Not for profit, not for fame, but for the purest passion for creation.

focus.label: FOCUS
focus.lead: The fields we love and keep cultivating.

i1.title: Survival Exploration
i1.desc: Guides forged in vanilla and modded survival, recording every adventure and discovery.

i2.title: Building & Design
i2.desc: Share builds and inspiration, from cozy huts to grand engineering projects.

i3.title: Redstone Engineering
i3.desc: Study redstone circuits and contraptions that set your ideas in motion.

i4.title: Mods & Resources
i4.desc: Explore mods, modpacks and resource packs that push the blocky world's boundaries.

what.label: WHAT
what.lead: What we do to keep the community thriving.

i1.title: Community Discussion
i1.desc: High-quality posts and conversations covering every corner of the game and beyond.

i2.title: Resource Sharing
i2.desc: Guides, modpacks and assets curated into a searchable community knowledge base.

i3.title: Events & Meetups
i3.desc: Online co-op and build events that turn solo play into shared joy.

i4.title: Q&A Support
i4.desc: Beginners ask, veterans answer — together we crack every hard problem.

values.label: VALUES
values.lead: In the name of blocks, we live by these spirits.

i1.title: Creation
i1.desc: Blocks combine freely, and so do we: everyone can build a world of their own.

i2.title: Curiosity
i2.desc: Stay curious about the unknown — new seeds, mods and playstyles await.

i3.title: Passion
i3.desc: "Lit" means ignited: we light up every gathering with genuine enthusiasm.

cta.label: CTA
cta.title: Join Us
cta.description: One block, one passion, built together. In the name of blocks, open to the world.

userRules.title: iGCraftLit User Rules

chapters.title: Chapter 1 General Provisions
paragraphs: iGCraftLit Community is an open community for all Stargazers. United by our dreams and strengthened through creativity, we advance in exploration and break through in innovation, building this community together with a truth-seeking spirit.

Rooted in an international outlook and open to users worldwide, this community is committed to being a global space that crosses borders, embraces diversity and enables equal exchange. These Rules are enacted to safeguard community order and protect the rights and interests of all users worldwide.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 Principles of Global Coexistence
items: This community advocates global coexistence, pluralism, inclusiveness and mutual respect. Stargazers of every country, region, ethnicity and cultural background may exchange here on equal terms.

Users shall respect different cultures, religious beliefs and customs, and must not discriminate against, attack or insult others on grounds of nationality, race, gender, religion, region or other differences.
This community is not affiliated with any state or political entity. Users shall independently comply with the laws of their location and with internationally recognized norms.
When navigating cultural differences, rationality, restraint and friendliness are the baseline of exchange; together we maintain a positive atmosphere across the global community.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 Account Management
items: Users must provide a genuine, working email address when registering.
Accounts are owned by iGCraftLit; users hold the right to use them. Transferring, renting out or selling accounts is prohibited.
Users shall keep their passwords secure. Losses caused by password disclosure are borne by the users themselves.
After successful registration the system automatically assigns an 11-digit iGMUid as the user's unique identifier in the community.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 Community Conduct and Legal Baselines
items: Users shall comply with the laws and regulations of their location and with internationally recognized legal standards, and must not use this community for any unlawful activity.

Publishing, disseminating or storing the following content is strictly prohibited, including but not limited to: pornography, obscenity, vulgarity or sexually suggestive content; violence, gore, terror, cruelty, suicide or self-harm content; incitement of hatred, discrimination, ethnic antagonism or religious conflict; false information, rumors, fraud, pyramid schemes or illegal advertising; infringement of others' privacy, portrait rights, reputation rights or intellectual property rights; viruses, trojans, game cheats, malicious code or cyber-attack tools; and violations concerning the protection of minors.
Spam flooding, malicious bumping, malicious reporting and other acts that disrupt community order are prohibited.
Respect others and discuss rationally; personal attacks, defamation, insults and threats against others are not allowed.
Engaging in any unauthorized commercial or political activity in the name of iGCraftLit is prohibited.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 Intellectual Property
items: The copyright of content users publish in the community belongs to the users.
Users authorize iGCraftLit to display, disseminate and store that content within the community.
Unauthorized reposting or plagiarism of others' original content is prohibited; offenders bear corresponding legal responsibility.
Users shall ensure their published content does not infringe any third party's intellectual property rights. Should a dispute arise, the publisher bears full responsibility.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 Violations and Quantified Penalties
chapters.intro: If a user's violations within the community are discovered by an administrator, they shall be handled in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and these Rules, and the following quantified penalties shall be applied to the violating account:

penalties.title: Particularly serious cases
penalties.detail: Particularly serious cases, violations of law, or repeated refusal to correct: a permanent ban, up to account deletion; the right to cooperate with law-enforcement investigations is reserved.

penalties.title: Compensation for losses
penalties.detail: Users who cause losses to the community or to third parties through violations shall bear corresponding liability for compensation.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 Supplementary Provisions
items: The right of interpretation of these Rules belongs to iGCraftLit Community.
These Rules take effect on the date of registration. Continued use of community services constitutes agreement to these Rules.

These Rules may be updated in line with legal requirements or community development. Updates will be published in community announcements, and continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated Rules.

items.q: Q1: What penalties follow a violation?
items.a: Based on severity, administrators apply the quantified penalties in Chapter 6: a warning, 1/3/7-day mutes, a 30-day ban, a permanent ban, and ultimately account deletion. Where the law is broken, we cooperate with law-enforcement investigations.

items.q: Q2: Can I transfer or sell my account?
items.a: No. Accounts are owned by iGCraftLit and users only hold usage rights. Transferring, renting out or selling accounts is prohibited.

items.q: Q3: What if I disagree with a penalty?
items.a: If you object to a penalty, contact the administrators through community notifications or via igcraftlit@outlook.com to request a review. We will verify the circumstances and reply.

items.q: Q4: How do Rule updates take effect?
items.a: Updates will be published in community announcements. Your continued use of community services means you accept the updated Rules.
